# Rebrand inventory

Tracked-source scan: 19409 files, 8642 matching text files, 44866 case-insensitive MetaMask/Consensys/fox occurrences, 999 media/font/animation files. This is an inventory, not a claim every asset has been visually cleared. Internal identifiers, upstream dependencies, service hosts, test fixtures and legal notices require justified retention; do not blind-replace them.

Full machine inventory: inventory.json.gz (gzip JSON with all line numbers/assets); image/animation metadata: ../../brand/assets/inventory-assets.json. Native exact-size generation contract is native-assets.json. SVG/Rive/video/typography/sound are listed even when no thumbnail decoder exists.
